description: Read OpenVibe.Zone's resource index (ADR-048): GET /api/v1/resources lists the zones Zone owns as a page of common.resource-summary@1 (common.resource-list-result@1, kind zone.object-zone, id zon_<ULID>, with the project_id of the Network project that owns it), and GET /api/v1/resources/:ovrn reads one. Every authority serves these for OpenVibe.Services to fan out and merge.
